name: Tiger 3
subtitle: Wing pick and roll
goal: Make it 2-on-1 with a ball screen on the wing.
options: Best: 2 attacking off the screen. Next: 4 on the roll. Nothing? Reverse it and try again.

steps.note: 4 sprints out and screens 2's defender. Run like a boss!
2 dribbles off the screen toward the middle. 4 rolls to the basket.
Nothing there? Reverse the ball and try again on the other side.
